notes: Flags: none (no glass, F-21). The anchor for the rug-free living room's conversation group (2026-10-24). In 'natural, light-oak veneer' with a 'soft elliptical shape with a raised edge, sturdy cross-base and elegant brass-colored feet' (Overview), so it has no corners at Maddie's height. 'Max. load 44 lb'. At 46 1/2" it is about half the KIVIK sofa's 89 3/4" (designers aim for half to two thirds of the sofa's length). Designer Nike Karlsson. 3 stars (4). In stock in IKEA Long Island, NY; click and collect free; home delivery to our ZIP (2026-10-24). The LACK 46 1/2x30 3/4" in white stained oak effect ($49.99, ikea-40431535) is the cheaper, square-cornered size up from the staged LACK; it was seen in the search and not opened. rooms: living-room, from the rug-free brief.
